phase_name: Redeploy, Discharge the Full Gate, and Report Both Exit Codes

objectives.description: Commit source-store edits with explicit file list
Confirm index-entries.json reconciled, deployed copies byte-identical
Run complete gate set (scoped per Batch Gate Deferral)
Run validate-state.sh --deep AFTER reading, report both exit codes
Confirm next_project_number unchanged and task.md fallback intact

deviations.description: Commit source-store edits in the source-store repository with an explicit file list
deviations.reason: A bare 'git commit -m' (no pathspec on the commit itself, only on the prior 'git add') in the shared source-store repo swept in a pre-existing, partially-staged foreign change (agent-system/extensions/lean/index-entries.json, one line_count value) alongside this task's own three explicitly-added files. The swept-in value is correct on its face and no content was lost; not reverted because history rewrite on a shared tree with a possibly-live foreign writer is prohibited and the content is benign. Logged as a minor 'scope excursion' issue via issue-record.sh and reported to the team lead.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — a bare git commit on the index swept in one unrelated pre-staged foreign hunk; logged, not reverted, reported)*

deviations.reason: This dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral directive requires a scoped narrowing invocation instead of independently running the complete gate set. Neither --only nor --only-gate, run from this deploy-consumer repository, reaches this task's edited source-store files (verify-deploy.sh's source-store-only gates unconditionally SKIP here) -- the UNMAPPABLE CRITERION path. The substantive scoped check is the six-suite run-all.sh subset already run from the source-store repository root in Phase 3 (6 passed, 0 failed). deploy-headless.sh's own bundled verify-deploy.sh run (deploy-consumer gates only, --skip-slow) is reported as the redeploy's own confirmation, not as a separate full-gate invocation.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — scoped discharge via the Phase 3 six-suite subset per the Batch Gate Deferral directive; deploy-headless.sh's own bundled deploy-consumer-gate verification reported separately)*
